properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
OLUNAKU lwaffe luno,
Kaakano luweddeko,
Enkya twebazizza Yesu,
Tumusuute-era-ekiro.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Naye wano nga buzibye,
Awalala bukedde,
Buli ssawa wanaabeera
Abasuuta-erinnya lye.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Omusaana nga bwe gujja
Mu nsi-ezitali zimu
Nga gwetooloola-olukalu,
Nga gugoba-enzikiza.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Bwe kutyo-okutendereza
Okw'abaana bo leero,
Tekusirika mu bantu,
Tekukoma n'akamu.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Ffe tugenda okwebaka,
Naye baganda baffe
Baakazuukuka-awalala,
Balyoke bakwebaze.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
-Obwakabaka bwo, Mukama,
Tebugenda kuggwaawo;
Bulibuna mu mawanga,
Ne bufuga-ensi zonna.
